description: This file defines an ACP stateful binding target driver with functions to resolve, ensure readiness, manage sessions, and reset ACP bindings, and exports it as a constant.

methods.name: toAcpStatefulBindingTargetDescriptor
methods.description: Converts session parameters into a stateful binding target descriptor, using session entry data or binding specifications.

methods.name: ensureAcpTargetReady
methods.description: Ensures the ACP target is ready by resolving its binding specification and calling the readiness function.

methods.name: ensureAcpTargetSession
methods.description: Ensures an ACP session is established by resolving its binding specification and calling the session function.

methods.name: resetAcpTargetInPlace
methods.description: Resets the ACP session in place with the given session key and reason.
